name: UCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's top singles title: its first holder in the owner's title history is The First, followed by Irishred; The First won it back at Scars and Stripes in September 2006 and still held it at Night of the Legends II.

name: UCW United States Championship
epitaph: Created at Civil War in June 2006 with a four-way match won by Adam Benjamin; Bryan Storms took it at Scars and Stripes and Dakota Smith from him in November 2006.

name: LVW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The title of Las Vegas Wrestling, which UCW bought in August 2006; its holder, Jimmy Donovan, is 'the only LVW champion ever'. Irishred won it at Night of the Legends II and spray-painted it into the B4B Championship, the 'Blood for Blood' belt, won by making an opponent bleed.
